judgements.reason: Universal covers has every stage built in the baseline - the cover and deck group, Deck(proj) ~= pi1, the Galois correspondence, the pi_n API and pi1(S^1) ~= Z with K(G,1) recognition - so nothing is missing; exchangeability has its de Finetti summit but still lacks the recurrent Markov-exchangeable-to-mixture implication and the converse Aldous-Hoover array representation.

Exchangeability's Layers 0-7 are complete, including ConditionallyIIDWith, the directing measure and all three routes, leaving only the two Layer 8 converses; character theory still has to build the cuspidal series of GL2(F_q) from the non-split torus and assemble the (q^2-1)-square table, plus the general Z[zeta_e] lift of the Dixon solver.

Character theory needs only the GL2(F_q) cuspidal representations and the general cyclotomic Dixon lift on top of a finished table theory (characterTable, Burnside, Frobenius's theorem, the Frobenius-Schur trichotomy are all in the baseline); algebraic curves still needs the cotrace and the Hurwitz genus formula, constant-field extensions with the ramification filtration, residues and the Delta_F ~= Omega_F comparison, the model classes, the 84(g-1) bound and the whole scheme dictionary.

Curves sits on an existing function-field stack (places, divisors, Riemann's theorem, Weil differentials, the different ideal) and names no other roadmap; K2 has no K-theory at all in the baseline and must first build K0/K1 and stable elementary groups, the stable Steinberg group, the plus construction and localisation sequence, and the etale norm-residue map before Matsumoto, Weil reciprocity and the Hilbert-symbol comparison can even be stated.

Class field theory's thirteen missing layers stand on a real substrate - Mathlib's Tate complex, TauCeti's Herbrand quotient, continuous cohomology, idele groups and the local unit filtration - whereas K2 must import four foundations absent from the library entirely (spectra and the plus construction, Quillen localisation, Milnor K-theory, the norm-residue map) before any symbol or reciprocity target is reachable.
